longdesc.para: The processor provides a variety of model-specific registers that are used to control and report on processor performance.

Virtually all MSRs handle system related functions and are not accessible to an application program.
One exception to this rule is the time-stamp counter.
MSRs can be read using the RDMSR/URDMSR/RDMSRLIST instructions and written with the WRMSR/WRMSRNS/UWRMSR/WRMSRLIST instructions.

The scope of an MSR defines the set of processors that access the same MSR using the MSR read and write instructions.
Thread-scope MSRs are unique to every logical processor.
Core-scope MSRs are shared by the threads in the same core; similarly for module-scope, die-scope, and package-scope.
